posts.title: Design Wall Monday - November 16, 2026
posts.description: Good Morning Quilters! For the past five days I have been at a quilt retreat, and am now adjusting to my real life back at home. posts.title: Design Wall Monday - November 9, 2026
posts.description: Good Morning Ladies! My Cousin’s Walk came back from the Longarm quilter on Friday. It is the biggest quilt I have ever made, and it will be great on our king sized bed. It is about 102” by 116”. I finished the binding last night, and it only needs a label to be complete. Here are pictures of it hanging over the railing at my house.
